decision_gates.C5_safe_window: Excluded from the main MIKU method after corrected deterministic ablation showed no independent benefit and one repeatable regression.

metric_notes.safety_truth: Unperturbed truth Scenario; planning input differs only in prediction_noise.
metric_notes.clearance: Minimum signed boundary distance between axis-aligned physical rectangles in straight-road SL coordinates; collision requires more than 1 mm penetration.
metric_notes.ttc: Minimum longitudinal TTC while physical lateral footprints overlap; absent values are null.
metric_notes.penalized_travel_time: Arrival time for collision-free arrivals; otherwise scenario horizon plus 5 s.
metric_notes.runtime: Wall time of the complete method call; B2 includes all coordination iterations.
metric_notes.effect_size: Paired Cohen dz on finite paired differences.
